logic_errors.issue: The memory guard exits even when stopping the container fails.
logic_errors.details: docker kill uses check=False; a nonzero result is ignored, and timeout exceptions also terminate monitoring. The inspected transient service has Restart=no. A Docker failure can therefore leave the container running under memory pressure with no guard. Mocked execution confirmed one failed kill followed by exit.
logic_errors.suggestion: Verify container termination, handle kill errors and timeouts explicitly, and maintain protection until shutdown is confirmed.

logic_errors.issue: Resume overwrites completed and partial evidence.
logic_errors.details: Only completed text suites are retained. Smoke tests, vision, concurrency, benchmarks and context checks rerun into their original filenames; failed or partial text suites also overwrite their previous checkpoints. Resuming the retained 100K failure can replace its raw answer and correct=false result. The status backup does not preserve those artifacts.
logic_errors.suggestion: Skip validated completed stages and preserve every previous attempt before rerunning failed or partial stages.

logic_errors.issue: The continuation script does not restrict itself to unstarted checks.
logic_errors.details: Every invocation resets extension status and reruns all three targets, replacing existing results with new needles and answers. It also overwrites status-before-context-extension.json. Mocked execution confirmed both result and backup replacement.
logic_errors.suggestion: Load existing progress, skip recorded checks, and make original status backups immutable.

logic_errors.issue: Continuation can clear an unrelated failure and report overall completion.
logic_errors.details: The script never validates the original blocked step, the 100K formatting failure, or completion of earlier stages before deleting error and setting complete_with_format_failure. In a mocked run, an earlier work_quality_suite API failure became overall completion after the three context checks.
logic_errors.suggestion: Validate the expected predecessor state and required receipts before starting; derive overall status from all stages and preserve unrelated failures.

suggestions: Add mocked regression coverage for failed or timed-out kills, repeated continuation, resume artifact preservation, and rejection of unrelated blocked states. The two staged tests pass but cover only CLI availability and wrapper imports.
Replace acceptance and safety assertions with explicit exceptions so Python optimization cannot disable model, result, health and context validation.
